capabilities: Build a note or folder of notes into a static website
Generate a print-ready PDF with running head and page numbers
Number sections and figures automatically with a scrolling contents rail
Preview the site live in a browser, rebuilding on every save
Publish the note and site with git, e.g. to GitHub Pages
extras: Desktop only. The built page fetches KaTeX from the jsDelivr CDN, but the plugin itself makes no network requests. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note or folder into a standalone website or print-ready PDF without separate site generators and manual typesetting.

relations.evidence: the Excalidraw plugin needs to be on
Whether to put it online with GitHub Pages
The built page loads KaTeX from the jsDelivr CDN for maths

summary: Publishing tool that builds a note or folder of notes into a clean single-page website and PDF, with a contents rail, numbered figures and git publishing.
